description: Assainissement - Bureaux d'études spécialisés - Département Calvados is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Calvados. Identification, with their contact details, of design offices specializing in sanitation in Calvados. Collection context As part of its mission to support the public services of collective sanitation, through the technical assistance service for sanitation of the departmental technical agency IngéEAU Calvados, the Department has identified the design offices present on its territory and also ... Coverage: Département du Calvados. The portal shows the English title as "Sanitation - Specialist design offices - Department Calvados" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département du Calvados. Its keywords include bureau-detudes, ingenierie, eau-usee, assainissement. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2024-11-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
